description: Use this when the user asks what a clothing fiber is or whether it's natural, synthetic or a concern to wear, for example "is modal a natural fiber", "is polyester bad for you", "what is Tencel", "is rayon a natural fiber", "is spandex as bad as polyester" or "what is regenerated cellulose". Returns Greener Closet's reviewed guide with sources when one exists, and says plainly when it has only limited information. Do not use this to score a whole garment label (use check_fabric_label).

fiber.description: One fiber or fiber family, e.g. "polyester", "Tencel", "bamboo viscose", "regenerated cellulose".

title: Explain a fiber
